what: Bash retry gate plan does not require gh-run-logs success before classifying, while Python gates rerun on logs.state == ready
scenario_or_breakage: If gh-run-logs itself fails with transient text, Bash may rerun but Python treats the log as unreadable and enters the fix loop
suggested_fix: Require gh_logs_rc == 0 before Bash calls is_transient_net_signature for rerun; any non-zero log fetch goes to the fix loop

what: Exhaustion mapping can collapse push/launcher-environment failures into ci-fix-exhausted despite the plan saying those stay STALLED
scenario_or_breakage: Push failed or no launcher tier can route to autonomous main-agent CI fix instead of a stall, and Bash lacks a reason on return 1 to preserve parity
suggested_fix: Keep non-code-fix failures as immediate STALLED in both paths; only map actual deterministic fixer exhaustion to ci-fix-exhausted
